captions.detailed: A portable air conditioning unit designed in a tall, column-like tower shape with a uniform light gray finish. The main body features rounded vertical edges and a horizontal ventilation grille on one of its lower sides. It includes two articulated parts: a rectangular vent door on the flat top face that rotates on a horizontal hinge, and a small rectangular service access panel near the bottom corner that swings open on a vertical hinge.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a portable tower air conditioner. It must feature a tall main body with rounded vertical corners, a top-mounted rectangular vent door that rotates on a horizontal hinge, and a lower side service panel that rotates on a vertical hinge.
captions.factory: Construct the main tower body using a box primitive with filleted vertical edges. Create the top vent door and the side service panel as separate thin rectangular plate geometries. Position the top vent door within a recessed pocket on the top face with a horizontal revolute joint, and attach the side service panel to the lower corner using a vertical revolute joint.
